# Accesserty UI Kit

> 15 Web Components with reusable semantics, keyboard interaction and focus
> handling. Component JavaScript has no runtime package dependencies. Plain HTML
> can load one full bundle or selected standalone component files. Vue/Nuxt and
> React 19/Next.js have integration modules and targeted fixtures.

WCAG 2.2 AA is the design target, not an automatic conformance guarantee. Tests
do not establish complete screen-reader or application compatibility.

Component classes load only in the browser. Servers can render hosts, attributes
and initial values. Only Accordion (including its items), Tabs and Breadcrumbs
can also receive server-rendered Shadow DOM through the injector.

## Key Links

- Repository: https://github.com/Accesserty/UI-Kit
- Component demos: demo/index.html
- Full API reference: demo/*.html (one file per component)
- Interactive playground: demo/playground.html
- Setup and framework integration: README.md
- Data, events and forms: docs/USAGE.md
- Upgrade from 2.x: UPGRADING.md
- Contributor setup and checks: CONTRIBUTING.md
- Current references and dated records: docs/README.md

## Project Structure

- `src/components/` — 15 component source files registering 18 tags (compound components include child tags). Most import shared modules; use distribution files for classic script tags.
- `src/views/` — Shadow DOM markup and styles for au-accordion, au-tabs and au-breadcrumbs, shared by the browser and server rendering
- `src/core/` — Code the components share: `declarative.js` (adopts a server-rendered declarative shadow root or builds one), `form-element.js` (`AuFormElement`, the base class of the 7 form controls), `aria.js` (forwards the host's name and description to the inner control), `upgrade.js` (properties set before definition), `id.js` (`uid()` for shadow-root ids)
- `src/ssr/inject.js` — Inserts declarative shadow roots into server-rendered HTML (whole strings or streams)
- `src/integrations/` — Vue (v-model), Nuxt module, React (value/checked + onChange) integrations
- `src/css/` — Optional repository stylesheet. au-style.css imports token files unlayered and components.css into the `accesserty` layer. Copy the whole folder; it is not in the package allow-list or exported as an npm subpath.
- `src/accesserty-ui-kit.js` — Bundle entry point (imports all components)
- `demo/` — Human-readable documentation with live examples and CSS variable tables
- `test/` — Browser-based unit tests using @web/test-runner and @open-wc/testing
- `dist/` — Build output: `accesserty-ui-kit.js` and `.min.js` (all components), `components/*.js` and `components/*.min.js` (one self-contained classic script per component, readable and minified), `.d.ts` declarations (`accesserty-ui-kit.d.ts` types every element and event detail), plus ES modules `accesserty-ui-kit-vue.js`, `-nuxt.js` (with its plugin files), `-react.js` and `-ssr.js`
- `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` — Technical architecture deep-dive

## Components

### au-accordion

- **Tag:** `<au-accordion>`, `<au-accordion-item>`
- **Attributes (au-accordion):** exclusive, data-text-exclusive-hint
- **Attributes (accordion-item):** open, heading-level (1–6; default 3), no-region
- **Slots (accordion-item):** heading (the question/title, inside the header button), sub
  (secondary text in the button), icon (decorative, aria-hidden), content (the panel). There is no
  default slot: a child without one of these slot names is not shown, and nothing warns about it.
  Example:
  `<au-accordion-item><span slot="heading">Question</span><div slot="content"><p>Answer</p></div></au-accordion-item>`
- **Properties:** open (boolean getter/setter), exclusive (on au-accordion)
- **Events:** au-toggle (detail: { open })

Events describe actual connected state changes, including programmatic updates and sibling
closures; same-value writes do not repeat events. Exclusive mode affects direct item children only
and normalizes initial/inserted state to the first open item. Nested groups are independent.
Native heading buttons support Enter/Space and normal Tab navigation; collapsing focused content
returns focus to its header. Heading/sub slots must be non-interactive. Panel visibility is
immediate. Collapsed panels use hidden="until-found" where supported (find-in-page and fragment
links open the item and emit au-toggle); elsewhere they are hidden and inert. Plain deferred
scripts (bundle or components/accordion.js) and pre-definition Boolean properties work. Element
definition is browser-only; the SSR injector can server-render the declarative shadow root
(open/collapsed state included).

- **Form-associated:** No
- **CSS variables:** 15+ (--au-accordion-heading-*, --au-accordion-content-*)

### au-breadcrumbs

- **Tag:** `<au-breadcrumbs>`
- **Attributes:** items (JSON array), separator, aria-label, aria-labelledby, label,
  data-link-title-prefix, data-link-title-template (`{text}`, `{index}`)
- **Properties:** items (getter/setter), separator (getter/setter)

Pre-registration items/separator assignments are replayed through the accessors. Items accepts an
array, JSON string or single item object. SSR integrations serialize the items attribute; without
the declarative Shadow DOM injector the internal links render only after client registration. With
the injector the server renders the nav, list and links (relative and HTTP(S) URLs only), so links
work without JavaScript; the component adopts them and re-validates URLs in the browser. Links use
native navigation, not framework router events. Translation retains link focus; a removed/revoked
focused link returns focus to the navigation landmark.

- **Events:** none
- **Form-associated:** No
- **CSS variables:** 8 (--au-breadcrumbs-*)

### au-card

- **Tag:** `<au-card>`
- **Slots:** heading, media, content, footer

Only named slots are projected, in that order; no default slot. The card adds no role, tabindex,
automatic heading semantics or custom events. Native child controls retain forms, reset and event
behavior. render() is idempotent and retains the shell/slots/focus. Default
block/min-inline-size/wrapping styles respect hidden; consumers own media sizes, content
semantics, themes and focus styling.

- **CSS Parts:** au-card-container, heading, media, content, footer

Parts refer to the container and slot elements; style assigned content through consumer selectors.
Real Next/Nuxt fixtures retain server host/content nodes and native event/form behavior, with
client-only registration. These are not screen-reader results.

- **Form-associated:** No
- **CSS variables:** 0 (styled via ::part())

### au-carousel

- **Tag:** `<au-carousel>`
- **Attributes:** aria-label, aria-labelledby, data-text-roledescription, data-live-template,
  data-item-fallback, data-dot-template, data-text-prev, data-text-next, data-text-pagination,
  data-text-instructions, data-icon-prev, data-icon-next; per slide (direct child): data-title
- **Localization templates:** data-dot-template, data-live-template, data-item-fallback support
  `{title}`, `{current}`, `{total}`
- **Content model:** each direct child element is one slide (author-defined native HTML); one
  pagination button per slide, named + positioned; responsive slides-per-view via @container
- **Properties:** current (getter/setter)

current is a zero-based DOM property, not an attribute; numeric strings/fractions normalize to a
bounded integer, invalid/non-finite inputs become 0, empty is -1. Pre-definition property
assignment is supported when slides exist at upgrade. Stable slide element identity preserves the
selected slide and dot focus across translation/reordering; new nodes are new identities.

- **Methods:** slideTo(index), refresh() (re-read slide titles after a runtime/locale change;
  also automatic via MutationObserver)
- **Events:** au-slide-change (detail: { index, total, title })

Changed navigation/current writes and settled scrolling emit; refresh/translation/reordering are
silent. Boundary arrows remain focusable aria-disabled controls and do not repeat events.
Scrolling uses the track start edge in LTR/RTL without scrolling outer containers. Named wrapper
references external labels across Shadow DOM; fallback naming is plain text. Forced-colors
outlines and a non-color current-dot ring remain visible; dots wrap at narrow widths. Off-screen
slides remain readable/tabbable; there is no autoplay or tabpanel model.

- **Form-associated:** No
- **SSR:** extends HTMLElement — defined in the browser only (the kit's Nuxt module and React
  defineElements() do this); not importable in Node
- **CSS variables:** 16 (--au-carousel-gap, --au-carousel-dot-*, --au-carousel-button-*,
  --au-carousel-controls-gap)

### au-checkbox

- **Tag:** `<au-checkbox>`
- **Attributes:** name, value, checked, disabled, required, label, aria-label, aria-labelledby,
  aria-describedby, aria-invalid
- **Properties:** checked (getter/setter), disabled (getter/setter)
- **Events:** change (detail: boolean), focus, blur
- **Form-associated:** Yes (setFormValue: value when checked, null when unchecked)
- **CSS variables:** 14+ (--au-checkbox-*)

### au-dropdown

- **Tags:** `<au-dropdown>`, `<au-dropdown-item>`
- **Attributes (au-dropdown):** data-text-trigger
- **Attributes (dropdown-item):** value
- **Properties:** isOpen (getter/setter on au-dropdown)
- **Events:** au-select (detail: { value }) on au-dropdown-item
- **Activation:** one au-select event per click/Enter/Space, including after reconnection;
  translated text/value updates are silent and retain focus.
- **Keyboard:** open(index) focuses immediately; arrows/Home/End navigate owned items across
  containing shadow roots; Escape restores trigger focus and Tab leaves using browser keyboard
  preferences.
- **Form-associated:** No
- **CSS variables:** 11 (--au-dropdown-menu-*, --au-dropdown-item-*,
  --au-dropdown-focus-shadow-*)

### au-file-upload

- **Tag:** `<au-file-upload>`
- **Attributes:** accept, multiple, name, disabled, required, label, max-files, max-size-mb,
  max-total-size-mb, msg-drop-text, msg-remove-text, msg-remove-file-label, msg-added,
  msg-removed, msg-required, msg-type-error, msg-size-error, msg-count-error, msg-total-size-error
  (file-upload uses the msg- prefix; other components use data-text-)
- **Localization templates:** msg-remove-file-label and msg-removed support `{fileName}`;
  msg-added supports `{count}`; msg-size-error supports `{fileName}` and `{maxSize}`;
  msg-count-error supports `{fileName}` and `{maxFiles}`; msg-total-size-error supports
  `{maxTotalSize}`
- **Properties:** value (getter/setter: File[])
- **Methods:** handleFiles(files), removeFile(file), checkValidity(), reportValidity()
- **Events:** change, au-remove-file (detail: File)
- **Form-associated:** Yes (ElementInternals FormData with actual File entries)
- **Default trigger:** native button named by label; a custom trigger should be a named button
  type=button. Disabled fields/fieldsets block picker/drop/removal and omit submission without
  losing selection. Validation focuses a visible region and shows inline errors. Drag/drop
  handling is scoped to the component. Without multiple, selection is capped at one; remove before
  replacement. Picker limits default to 5 files, 5MB each and 20MB total; invalid limits use
  defaults and zero is valid. Extensions/MIME matching is case-insensitive; same name/size
  duplicates are ignored. The controlled value setter copies File entries, bypasses picker limits,
  and emits no change. Removal emits au-remove-file then change once; reset is silent. Translation
  retains remove-button identity. Pre-registration value assignments survive deferred loading.
  Client-only registration is required for SSR; File values cannot be serialized as an HTML
  attribute.
- **CSS variables:** 20+ (--au-file-upload-label-*, --au-file-upload-area-*,
  --au-file-upload-delete-*, --au-file-upload-file-list-*,
  --au-file-upload-trigger-focus-outline-*)

### au-input

- **Tag:** `<au-input>`
- **Attributes:** type, name, value, placeholder, required, disabled, readonly, label,
  aria-label, aria-labelledby, min, max, step, pattern, autocomplete, inputmode, maxlength,
  minlength, list, data-size (small|large), data-layout (vertical), data-clear, data-clear-label,
  id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid
- **Properties:** value (getter/setter), disabled, required, readonly (all getter/setter),
  validity, validationMessage, willValidate, valueAsNumber and valueAsDate (as on a native input),
  setCustomValidity() and form (all seven form components)
- **Methods:** focus(), clear(), suggest(val), checkValidity(), reportValidity()
- **Slots:** prefix, affix
- **Events:** input, change (bubbles, composed)
- **Form-associated:** Yes
- **CSS variables:** 22 (--au-input-wrapper-bg, --au-input-label-*, --au-input-padding-*,
  --au-input-text-*, --au-input-border-*, --au-input-bg, --au-input-focus-shadow-*,
  --au-input-invalid-shadow-*, --au-input-clear-*, --au-input-small-*, --au-input-large-*,
  --au-input-container-*)

### au-pagination

- **Tag:** `<au-pagination>`
- **Attributes:** data-total, data-current-page, data-pager-count, data-page-size,
  data-page-size-options, data-layout, data-text-* (localization)
- **Localization attributes:** data-text-total-pages-prefix, data-text-page,
  data-text-total-items-suffix, data-text-per, data-text-first, data-text-prev, data-text-next,
  data-text-last, data-text-go, data-text-goto, data-text-pagination-label, data-text-page-size,
  data-text-page-announcement (`{page}`)
- **Properties:** pageSizeOptions (getter/setter), layout (getter/setter), totalPages (getter),
  pagers (getter)
- **Events:** au-page-change (detail: page number), au-page-size-change (detail: size)
- **Form-associated:** No
- **CSS variables:** inherits --au-btn-* from button styles

### au-radio-group

- **Tags:** `<au-radio-group>`, `<au-radio>` (slotted children)
- **Attributes (au-radio-group):** disabled, required, direction (vertical), aria-label,
  aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, aria-invalid, label

`label` draws a visible group label above the options and names the group by it (since 3.0.3;
before, it was only an accessible name and nothing was shown). Use `aria-label` alone when the
group needs a name but no visible label, or `aria-labelledby` to point at your own visible
label; either one takes precedence over `label` as the name. Do not combine `label` with your
own visible label text, or the label appears twice.

`required` sets aria-required on the group and makes the group invalid until an option is
selected; aria-describedby and aria-invalid are forwarded to the group, so an error message can be
attached as described in "Form validation and error messages".

- **Attributes (au-radio):** value, checked, disabled, label
- **Properties:** value (getter/setter — currently selected), name, disabled, required
  (getter/setter)
- **Events:** change (detail: { value })
- **Form-associated:** Yes (au-radio-group)
- **CSS variables:** 15 (--au-radio-content-gap, --au-radio-input-*, --au-radio-label-*,
  --au-radio-group-label-text-color, --au-radio-group-label-text-size,
  --au-radio-group-label-padding-vertical)

### au-rating

- **Tag:** `<au-rating>`
- **Attributes:** value, max, labels (comma-separated), name, show-score, score-info, disabled,
  readonly, aria-label, data-text-rating, data-text-star (`{value}`, `{max}`), data-text-score
  (`{value}`, `{max}`, `{scoreInfo}`)
- **Properties:** value, max, labels, name, showScore, scoreInfo, disabled, readonly (all
  getter/setter)
- **Events:** change (detail: { value: number })
- **Form-associated:** Yes
- **CSS variables:** 12 (--au-rating-gap, --au-rating-star-*, --au-rating-focus-*,
  --au-rating-label-*, --au-rating-score-*)

### au-switch

- **Tag:** `<au-switch>`
- **Attributes:** name, value, checked, disabled, label, aria-label, aria-labelledby, on, off
- **Slots:** default (label text). `label` provides fallback label text when no slotted label is
  supplied.
- **Properties:** checked (getter/setter), disabled (getter/setter)
- **Events:** change (detail: boolean — checked state)
- **Form-associated:** Yes (setFormValue: value when checked, null when unchecked)
- **CSS variables:** 17 (--au-switch-gap, --au-switch-padding-*, --au-switch-container-gap,
  --au-switch-input-*, --au-switch-inner-*, --au-switch-focus-shadow-*)

### au-tabs

- **Tag:** `<au-tabs>`
- **Children:** elements with `slot="panel"` and class `au-tab-panel` (per panel: label,
  label-lang, data-badge); the component sets role="tabpanel"
- **Attributes:** selected-index, aria-label, aria-labelledby
- **Localization attributes:** data-text-tab (`{index}` fallback tab label), data-text-tab-lang,
  data-text-badge-label-prefix
- **Properties:** selectedIndex (getter/setter)
- **Events:** au-tab-change (detail: { index, label })
- **SSR:** the declarative Shadow DOM injector renders the tab list with the `selected-index` tab
  selected and only its panel shown; the component adopts that root in the browser
- **Form-associated:** No
- **CSS variables:** 26 (--au-tabs-*, --au-tabpanels-*, --au-tab-panel-*, --au-tab-badge-*)

### au-textarea

- **Tag:** `<au-textarea>`
- **Attributes:** value, placeholder, name, rows, cols, disabled, readonly, required, maxlength,
  minlength, label, aria-label, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, aria-invalid, id
- **Properties:** value (getter/setter), disabled, readonly (getter/setter), validity,
  validationMessage, willValidate
- **Methods:** checkValidity(), reportValidity()
- **Events:** input, change (bubbles, composed)
- **Form-associated:** Yes
- **CSS variables:** 15 (--au-textarea-label-*, --au-textarea-container-*,
  --au-textarea-padding-*, --au-textarea-text-*, --au-textarea-border-*, --au-textarea-bg,
  --au-textarea-focus-shadow-*, --au-textarea-invalid-shadow-*, --au-textarea-readonly-*)

### au-tree

- **Tags:** `<au-tree>`, `<au-tree-node>` (auto-created from data)
- **Attributes (au-tree):** show-checkbox, aria-label, aria-labelledby, data-text-node,
  data-text-toggle (`{label}`)
- **Properties (au-tree):** data (getter/setter — JS object tree), toggleLabel (getter/setter),
  fallbackNodeLabel (getter/setter), toggleLabelTemplate (getter/setter)
- **Events:** change (on au-tree, when checkbox state changes)
- **Data:** use sibling-unique id values to retain nodes, focus and state across object
  replacement; otherwise identity uses the original objects. Labels are plain text. Optional lang
  sets node language.
- **State:** leaf checked and branch expanded fields are reapplied on data assignment; omitted
  fields retain local state. Disabled branches block checkbox actions/cascades but allow
  navigation and expansion. Parent checks aggregate enabled children.
- **Events:** one change.detail.checkedNodes array for an actual check operation; data/locale
  updates are silent and do not mutate input objects. Assign data as a DOM property, not JSON
  markup.
- **Form-associated:** No
- **CSS variables:** 30+ (--au-tree-*, --au-tree-node-*, --au-tree-node-checkbox-*,
  --au-tree-node-toggle-*)

## Form validation and error messages

au-input, au-textarea, au-checkbox and au-radio-group do not draw error text themselves. To show
an error next to a field, as `demo/form.html` does:

1. Put an error-text element next to the field. Reference it with
   `aria-describedby`, for example:
   `<au-input label="Email" required aria-describedby="email-error"></au-input><p id="email-error"></p>`.
2. When validation fails, fill that element and set host `aria-invalid="true"`.
   Clear the message and invalid state when the error is resolved. The component
   forwards the description and invalid state to its control. Input and Textarea
   also follow later changes to the referenced text. Actual speech depends on
   the browser and assistive technology.
3. On submit, focus the first invalid field with `element.focus()`, or focus an
   error summary with links to the fields.

`setCustomValidity()` with `reportValidity()` only shows the browser's own validation bubble for
one field at a time; it does not set aria-invalid or show inline text. Use it for native
constraint behavior (blocking submission), not as the visible error message. au-file-upload is the
exception: it validates type, size and count itself and shows inline errors.

## Accessibility presentation of form controls

The visible control lives in the shadow root, not on the host. The table records
the naming, description and focus contracts. Chrome accessibility-tree checks and
the documented Safari+VoiceOver application-form check cover selected behavior,
not every table entry in every integration. Known speech limits follow the table.

| Component | Role | Accessible name from | Forwarded from the host | `focus()` goes to |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| au-input | textbox (the inner `<input>`; type-specific, e.g. email field) | `label`, else `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` on the host, else a `<label for>` pointing at the host | `required` (exposed as required), `aria-describedby` (description), `aria-invalid` | the inner input |
| au-textarea | textbox, multi-line (the inner `<textarea>`) | same as au-input | same as au-input | the inner textarea |
| au-checkbox | checkbox | the element's text, or `label` | `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid`; `required` affects validity only (ARIA has no required state for checkboxes) | the inner checkbox |
| au-switch | switch | the element's text, or `label` | `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid` | the inner input |
| au-radio-group | radiogroup; each au-radio is a radio named by its text or `label` | `aria-labelledby`, else `aria-label`, else `label` on au-radio-group (`label` is also drawn as the visible group label since 3.0.3) | `required` (on the group), `aria-describedby` (on the group), `aria-invalid` (on the group and every radio) | the radio in the tab order (the selected one, else the first enabled one) |

- `aria-invalid` (since 3.0.2): when the host has no `aria-invalid`, the inner controls get `aria-invalid="false"`. Without it, Safari+VoiceOver announces every empty required field as "invalid data" as soon as the page loads, because WebKit maps native validity to the invalid state. Set `aria-invalid="true"` on the host when you show an error and remove it when the error is fixed. A failed browser-validated submit still announces the browser's validation message.
- Known limitation: the host keeps the `aria-describedby` and `aria-invalid` attributes you set, and a form-associated host reports its validity, so the host is also exposed as a generic element with the same description and invalid state. Safari+VoiceOver reads the description twice for au-textarea and au-checkbox (once on the control, once on the surrounding group).

## Technical Stack

- Runtime: Vanilla Custom Elements v1, Shadow DOM (open), ElementInternals API
- CSS: Custom Properties, Cascade Layers, CSS Nesting, oklch color space
- Build: Vite 8/Rolldown (full bundles) + Rollup scripts for the integrations and `dist/components/`, minified with @rollup/plugin-terser
- Testing: @web/test-runner 1, @open-wc/testing 5, browser and isolated framework fixtures
- Development: Node.js from `.nvmrc`, npm 11; browser bundles do not require Node.js

## Design Decisions

- No framework dependency — components must work from a `<script>` tag alone (the full bundle or a `dist/components/` file; source files are ES modules that import `src/core/` and `src/views/`)
- Shadow DOM mode is always `open` (accessible to testing and DevTools)
- Use documented CSS variables and exposed parts for appearance. Card uses parts and consumer selectors instead of component-specific variables.
- Accordion panel visibility is immediate; reduced motion disables header/icon transitions
- Form controls extend `AuFormElement`: `formAssociated` + ElementInternals for native form participation (no hidden inputs)
- Public `au-*` events bubble and are composed so listeners can receive them across Shadow DOM boundaries. Form components retain their native-named `input` and `change` events.
- Components that need generated IDs use `uid()` in `src/core/id.js` (`crypto.getRandomValues()`). Shared server/browser views use fixed IDs scoped to each shadow root.
- `customElements.define()` is guarded with `typeof customElements !== 'undefined'` and `customElements.get()`, so loading a file twice or several overlapping files defines each element once; the class declarations still need a DOM, so component files are not importable in Node
- Declarative Shadow DOM for au-accordion, au-tabs and au-breadcrumbs only: `src/views/` renders the same markup on the server (`src/ssr/inject.js`) and in the browser, and `src/core/declarative.js` adopts a server-rendered root. On by default in the Nuxt module (`declarativeShadowDom: false` turns it off); Next.js only via `withDeclarativeShadow` on a custom server
